name: Stock State
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item_code,
    sle.warehouse,

    -- Sum of movements AFTER last zero
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN sle.posting_datetime > (
            IFNULL((
                SELECT z.posting_datetime
                FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
                WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
                AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
                AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
                ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ), 0))
            THEN sle.actual_qty
            ELSE 0
        END
    )
    +
    IFNULL((
        SELECT z.qty_after_transaction
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
        WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
        AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
        AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
        ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS final_qty

FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
WHERE sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
GROUP BY sle.item_code, sle.warehouse

name: Stock State Lightweight
query:
SELECT item_code, warehouse, final_qty
FROM (
    SELECT 
        item_code, 
        warehouse, 
        qty_after_transaction AS final_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_code, warehouse ORDER BY creation DESC, name DESC) as row_num
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
    WHERE warehouse = %(warehouse)s 
      AND is_cancelled = 0
) t
WHERE row_num = 1;

name: Best Sell Report
query:
WITH sold_items AS (
    SELECT 
        sii.item_code,
        SUM(sii.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si 
        ON sii.parent = si.name
    WHERE 
        si.docstatus = 1
        AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
        AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR si.company = %(company)s)
        AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR sii.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
    GROUP BY sii.item_code
    HAVING SUM(sii.qty) > 0
),

monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        sii.item_code,
        YEAR(si.posting_date) AS y,
        MONTH(si.posting_date) AS m,
        SUM(sii.qty) AS qty_month
    FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si 
        ON sii.parent = si.name
    WHERE
        si.docstatus = 1
        AND si.posting_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 MONTH) AND CURDATE()
        AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR si.company = %(company)s)
        AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR sii.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
    GROUP BY sii.item_code, y, m
),

ranked AS (
    SELECT
        item_code,
        y,
        m,
        qty_month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_code
            ORDER BY qty_month DESC, y DESC, m DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM monthly_sales
)

SELECT 
    s.item_code,
    s.total_qty,
    COALESCE(r.qty_month, 0) AS best_sell_qty,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.y IS NOT NULL AND r.m IS NOT NULL
        THEN CONCAT(r.y, '-', LPAD(r.m, 2, '0'), '-01')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS best_sell_month,
    COALESCE(b.actual_qty, 0) AS on_stock

FROM sold_items s
LEFT JOIN ranked r 
    ON r.item_code = s.item_code AND r.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN `tabBin` b 
    ON b.item_code = s.item_code
    AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR b.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)

ORDER BY s.item_code
